pr_title: Allow not finding attribute data for more cases that we don't care about
pr_body:
This will fix the upstream repo intake of dotnet/runtime by allowing us to fall back to null for cases where Roslyn does things that we aren't expecting with the "ContainingSymbol" value.

Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/72622

issue_context.title: MarshallingAttributeAnalyzers throws InvalidOperationException
issue_context.body:
### Description

NativeMarshallingAttributeAnalyzer and CustomMarshallerAttributeAnalyzer are throwing exceptions when building the runtime repo.

### Reproduction Steps

Set `dotnet_diagnostic.AD0001.severity = error` in `eng/CodeAnalysis.src.globalconfig`, and run `build.cmd`

### Expected behavior

No errors

### Actual behavior

I get lots of errors like the following:

```
CSC : error AD0001: Analyzer 'Microsoft.Interop.Analyzers.CustomMarshallerAttributeAnalyzer' threw an exception of type 'System.InvalidOperationException' with me 
ssage 'Sequence contains no elements'. [C:\Users\svbomer\src\runtime\src\coreclr\System.Private.CoreLib\System.Private.CoreLib.csproj]
```
```
CSC : error AD0001: Analyzer 'Microsoft.Interop.Analyzers.NativeMarshallingAttributeAnalyzer' threw an exception of type 'System.InvalidOperationException' with m 
essage 'Sequence contains no elements'. [C:\Users\svbomer\src\runtime\src\coreclr\System.Private.CoreLib\System.Private.CoreLib.csproj]
```
```
CSC : error AD0001: Analyzer 'Microsoft.Interop.Analyzers.CustomMarshallerAttributeAnalyzer' threw an exception of type 'System.InvalidCastException' with message 'Unable to cast object of type 'Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Symbols.PublicModel.ArrayTypeSymbol' to type 'Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.INamedTypeSymbol'.'. [C:\Users\svbomer\src\runtime\src\coreclr\nativeaot\System.Private.CoreLib\src\System.Private.CoreLib.csproj]
```

### Regression?

_No response_

### Known Workarounds

_No response_

### Configuration

### Other information
